hello~ i love your artstyle and the design commission you did sm so i decided to make a request for my oc as well! 

i put double the suggested price with a hope you can design 2 outfits for my oc, but if you only want to make one, thats cool too! please add 1-2 items along side with the design in that case. 

about my oc Cyan, he's a scientist, 178cm tall, 25 years old and have a shy/introverted/nerdy personality. fav colors palette mostly is cool tones (blue, cyan, indigo, purple, navy or white). his sign is pisces so anything related to the sea or fishes are highly recommended!

the theme for the outfits could be up to you, though i hope it could be modern. i have attached some outfit references, but you dont have to choose the exact theme if you feel like its not your style!

thank you so much for your consideration 🥹

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/13FBuT_DUCCHWPvxIZp-JaEete8ZZg5Mc

Hi, I love your artstyle and would like to send you a request!

Can you design new outfits for my two OCs? The theme is post-apocalypse and the style is similar to “Arknights”.

References: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10TL9QLipmQQflQ758lzGdH-XAERalKir

White-haired guy (180cm, black eyes, color palette: white, light blue, black): always smiles, outgoing.
Black-haired guy (170cm, black eyes, color palette: black, dark blue): doesn’t smile, serious.

Please draw anything that you think will suit them.

If the amount is not enough, please make an appeal.

Thank you so much!
